title: Postern error response
description: Body of every non-2xx Postern response. See SPEC.md section 2.1.

code.description: not_entitled is only valid from a local runner reporting its own state. Distributors MUST answer not_found instead, so the entitlement endpoint cannot be used to enumerate a private catalogue.

message.description: Human-readable; SHOULD be safe to show a user verbatim.
